prior_book.invalidation: Reduce or close if Canadian core inflation moves decisively above the current near-2% zone while employment and wage growth reaccelerate, or if BoC communication/delivered hikes validate a 2027 path in the mid-3% area. A headline-energy spike without confirmation in core inflation and labor is not sufficient invalidation.
